notes.title: Build 1.0.3
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey folks,[/b][/p][p]Thanks for waiting on this little patch, some of the smaller bugs that popped up since the last build took a bit of extra time to fix. Here’s what’s been sorted out:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed scooter handlebar hanger collider.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the deck rack colliders a bit bigger to avoid issues with longboards.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved auto-relocating in case you get locked out, and added a safe area in front of the door.[/p][/*][*][p]Starter items now save properly.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s been just about a week since launch, and I’m honestly over the moon. This has been such a huge learning experience, and I couldn’t have done it without you all. [b]Thank you[/b] so much for your patience, your support, and for being part of Skatehouse 🧡[/p]

notes.title: Build 1.0.2
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks,[/p][p]Here are a few small bug fixes that popped up since launch:[/p][list][*][p]Magazines, wax, and the boombox can no longer be purchased if you don’t have enough cash.[/p][/*][*][p]Griptape Tier III and IV now correctly appear when selling boards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an invisible wall collider in the second shop upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Put in a shop boundary collider as an extra safety net.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-walk should be fixed now (fingers crossed).[/p][/*][/list][p]I just want to say a [b]huge thank you[/b] for supporting my very first little game. It means the world to me, and I really hope you’re enjoying your time in Skatehouse 🧡[/p]

notes.title: Skatehouse is OUT NOW!
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm proud to finally say that [b]Skatehouse is out now![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support over the last year or so while I've been developing this game. This is my first game, and I made it while working a full-time job. I'm excited to see what you all think of it![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="D_62rk1QuXA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]What's in the game?[/h2][p]Here's a short list of everything you can expect to find in the game:[/p][list][*][p]Skateboards[/p][/*][*][p]Cruisers[/p][/*][*][p]Longboards[/p][/*][*][p]Penny boards[/p][/*][*][p]Clothing[/p][/*][*][p]Scooters[/p][/*][*][p]BMXs[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of decorations (including a TV with skate videos!)[/p][/*][/list][p]I've also added a few systems for building custom boards, hiring staff, and sponsoring riders![/p][p][/p][p]This is a small game (approx. 4-5 hours). It is a simplified version of a shop simulator, focusing mainly on building and decorating your shop, as well as fulfilling orders and managing staff. There are no customers walking around the shop.[/p][p][/p][h2]Launch discount[/h2][p]For the first two weeks, you can get Skatehouse with a [b]-20% discount[/b]. This is my way of saying thank you for tagging along during development![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153020/Skatehouse/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, from Tyler :orange_heart:[/p]

notes.title: Demo 2.0 for Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks,[/p][p][/p][p]With Next Fest coming up, I’ve updated the Skatehouse demo with some new content, improvements, and features based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Before we get started, I want to take a moment to say a huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played the demo. With that said...[/p][p][/p][h2]What's new?[/h2][p][/p][h3]🛠️ BMX Workstation:[/h3][p]BMXs are now in! That means 6 new parts, most of which need furniture to display.[/p][p][/p][h3]📘 New Tutorial: [/h3][p]A clearer tutorial helps you make your first sale, speed up production, and buy furniture.[/p][p][/p][h3]⏱️ Timed Custom Orders: [/h3][p]Custom orders now have timers. Miss them, and your shop rating will drop.[/p][p][/p][h3]🏆 Steam Achievements: [/h3][p]Track your progress with new goals, like selling your first 100 skateboards.[/p][p][/p][h3]🪑 Sell Furniture & Decorations: [/h3][p]You can now sell furniture and decor—just note, you’ll only get half the value back.[/p][p][/p][h3]💸 Dynamic Decoration Pricing: [/h3][p]Decoration prices now scale with shop growth. The more you place, the more they cost.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 Other: [/h3][p]Bug fixes and small tweaks.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for today—thanks again for being part of Skatehouse’s journey. Can’t wait to hear what you think of the new update. [/p][p][/p][p]See you at Next Fest![/p]
